rules.prepare:
# As in Alpine: on musl the programs that show who is logged in (w) use # utmps, see the util-linux recipe. if [ "$AELTRA_LIBC_NAME" = "musl" ]; then UTMPS_CFLAGS="$("${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-pkg-config" --cflags libutmps)" UTMPS_LIBS="$("${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-pkg-config" --libs libutmps)"
export CFLAGS="${CFLAGS:--g -O2} $UTMPS_CFLAGS" export LIBS="$LIBS $UTMPS_LIBS" fi
# The options of Debian's rules, without systemd and with --disable-nls. # The configure script of the release is used, Debian makes it again. As # in Debian the build is done in the source folder: the makefile for the # translated manual pages does not find them from another one. cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --disable-silent-rules \ --enable-watch8bit \ --enable-colorwatch \ --enable-w-from \ --enable-skill \ --enable-libselinux \ --disable-pidof \ --disable-modern-top \ --disable-nls
rules.install:
mkdir -p "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/procps" mkdir -p "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/sysctl"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/procps" install
install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/sysctl/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/sbin" mv "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/procps/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/sbin/sysctl" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/sysctl/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/sbin"
rm -f "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/procps/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/libproc2.la"
